name: voxbot
description: Let Claude use Voxbot on your Mac — drive your apps, type for you, and check your film projects.
long_description:
Voxbot is the voice assistant in your Mac's menu bar. With this extension Claude can hand Voxbot a job — open and control apps like After Effects, Premiere and Photoshop, type at the cursor, tidy a folder, or look up how a Voxbot film project stands.

Voxbot has to be installed and running (get it at zxrstudios.com/voxbot). Anything that costs credits — films, renders, character sheets, audio, music, images — never starts from Claude: Voxbot shows a Yes / Not yet card on your Mac and waits for your own click.

tools.name: voxbot_do
tools.description: Ask Voxbot to do something on your Mac, in plain language.

tools.name: voxbot_type
tools.description: Type text wherever your cursor is.

tools.name: voxbot_organize_folder
tools.description: Sort a folder's files into type sub-folders.

tools.name: voxbot_status
tools.description: Where a Voxbot film project stands.

tools.name: voxbot_sheets
tools.description: A project's character, prop and location sheets.
